coverage: Month-wide root query plus targeted topic recovery and date-window followups. Coverage is fragmentary: full transcripts and many original prompts remain unavailable. No absent date is interpreted as proof of no mathematics.
source_gaps: Truncated replies and unsuccessful source windows are preserved in raw receipts. No missing formulas, empirical data, user wording or formal verification runs are manufactured.
new_work_boundary: Every revised prompt and mathematical development is newly authored from its source fragment. Classical theorem inputs are named explicitly; finite verifier checks do not establish all general theorems, empirical performance or historical completeness.

verification.scope: Exact finite arithmetic, matrices, finite fields and rational examples, plus explicitly labeled elementary-function or quadrature checks.

coverage_topics: June13 musical logarithms and Hamiltonian tuning
June17 transportation correlation and scenario algebra
June22 nonlinear dyads and variational inverse problems
exclusions: Political narratives, medical/transdermal claims, unrelated June12 medical retrieval, and bare nonmathematical percentages are not developed as mathematics. Reconstructed2026 files are excluded as historical evidence. Query-like retrieval phrasing is not treated as a literal original question.
implementation_boundary: False universal motivic-to-Betti and projective-space window formulas are repaired. Pseudocode/postulates are not counted as machine-checked theorems. No full source code or empirical performance is claimed to have been inspected.
